item.title: Jim Beam Closes Kentucky Distillery for Year
item.description: Jim Beam halts distillation at its flagship Clermont, Kentucky, distillery throughout 2026, shifting production to its larger Booker Noe facility in Boston, Kentucky. The pause allows time for site upgrades while addressing oversupply and declining demand in the bourbon market.
